rows.text: A brilliant reversal, a meticulous deduction, a novel framework... All those elusive flashes of inspiration across every field vanish in an instant, leading to immense intellectual waste. Leveraging Memory Bubble technology, the Candelagraphos created specialized containers to preserve such sparks, classifying them by quality into different colors: the finest in orange, the poorest in blue. Yet before The Riddlers could intervene, they voluntarily abandoned the research. After all, realizing an idea is far more difficult than proposing it. And for the planet's elite researchers, if a suggestion goes unadopted, it might as well be forgotten.
